content.arabic: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
content.english: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies Allah. The kingdom and all praise belong to Him, and He has power over everything.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
content.english: Actions are judged by intentions, and each person receives according to what they intended.

content.arabic: لَا يُؤْخَذُ عَلَى الْأَذَانِ رِزْقٌ
content.english: No fixed payment should be taken for giving the adhan.

content.arabic: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنْكُمْ كَافِرٌ وَمِنْكُمْ مُؤْمِنٌ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
content.english: He created you; among you are those who disbelieve and those who believe. Allah fully sees what you do.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً
content.english: By Allah, I seek Allah’s forgiveness and repent to Him more than seventy times each day.

content.arabic: كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُتَّخَذَ الْجُعْلُ فِي الْأَذَانِ إِلَّا أَنْ يُعْطَى شَيْئًا بِغَيْرِ شَرْطٍ
content.english: He disliked taking a stipulated wage for the adhan, unless something was given without prior condition.

content.arabic: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ
content.english: He created the heavens and earth with truth, fashioned you well, and to Him is the final return.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَى أَجْسَامِكُمْ، وَلَا إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ، وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ
content.english: Allah does not look at your bodies or appearances; He looks at your hearts and deeds.

content.arabic: الْأَذَانُ شِعَارُ الْإِيمَانِ
content.english: The adhan is a distinguishing sign of faith.

content.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
content.english: He knows what is in the heavens and earth, what you hide and disclose, and what lies within hearts.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: لَا تَغْضَبْ
content.english: Do not become angry.

content.arabic: الْمُؤَذِّنُونَ أَطْوَلُ النَّاسِ أَعْنَاقًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
content.english: The callers to prayer will have the most distinguished stature on the Day of Resurrection.

content.arabic: فَآمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَالنُّورِ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْنَا وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
content.english: Believe in Allah, His Messenger, and the light He sent down. Allah is fully aware of all that you do.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
content.english: Be mindful of Allah wherever you are; follow a bad deed with a good one, and treat people with good character.

content.arabic: الْمُؤَذِّنُونَ أَطْوَلُ النَّاسِ أَعْنَاقًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
content.english: The mu’adhdhins will be especially distinguished on the Day of Resurrection.

content.arabic: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
content.english: Glorious is the One in whose hand is all dominion, and He is powerful over everything.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ ... احْرِصْ عَلَى مَا يَنْفَعُكَ، وَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْجِزْ
content.english: The strong believer is better and dearer to Allah. Pursue what benefits you, seek Allah’s help, and do not give up.

content.arabic: إِنَّ الْمُؤَذِّنَ يُغْفَرُ لَهُ مَدَى صَوْتِهِ، وَيُصَدِّقُهُ كُلُّ رَطْبٍ وَيَابِسٍ سَمِعَهُ
content.english: The mu’adhdhin is forgiven as far as his voice reaches, and every living and dry thing that hears him bears witness.

content.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفُورُ
content.english: He created death and life to test which of you is best in deeds. He is the Mighty, the Most-Forgiving.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: لَا تَحْقِرَنَّ مِنَ الْمَعْرُوفِ شَيْئًا وَلَوْ أَنْ تَلْقَى أَخَاكَ بِوَجْهٍ طَلْقٍ
content.english: Never regard a good deed as insignificant, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.

content.arabic: فَضْلُ الصَّلَاةِ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ خَمْسٌ وَعِشْرُونَ ضِعْفًا
content.english: Prayer in congregation carries twenty-five times the merit.

content.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
content.english: Those who stand in awe of their Lord without seeing Him have forgiveness and a great reward.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: كُلُّ مَعْرُوفٍ صَدَقَةٌ
content.english: Every recognized good deed is charity.

content.arabic: صَلَاةٌ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ خَمْسٍ وَعِشْرِينَ صَلَاةً يُصَلِّيهَا وَحْدَهُ
content.english: A prayer with the imam is better than twenty-five prayers offered alone.

content.arabic: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ
content.english: Would the One who created not know? He is the Most-Subtle, the All-Aware.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَى خَيْرٍ فَلَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ فَاعِلِهِ
content.english: Whoever guides someone to good receives a reward like the one who performs it.

content.arabic: فَضْلُ صَلَاةِ الْجَمِيعِ عَلَى صَلَاةِ الْوَاحِدِ خَمْسٌ وَعِشْرُونَ دَرَجَةً
content.english: Congregational prayer is twenty-five degrees superior to praying alone.

content.arabic: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَامْشُوا فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا مِنْ رِزْقِهِ وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
content.english: He made the earth manageable for you; travel through it, eat from His provision, and to Him is the resurrection.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ
content.english: Religion is sincere counsel and sincere concern.

content.arabic: صَلَاةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي الْجَمِيعِ تَفْضُلُ عَلَى صَلَاةِ الرَّجُلِ وَحْدَهُ أَرْبَعًا وَعِشْرِينَ صَلَاةً
content.english: A man’s prayer with the congregation exceeds his solitary prayer by twenty-four prayers.

content.arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَى
content.english: Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor has He become displeased with you.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
content.english: A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe.

content.arabic: فَضْلُ صَلَاةِ الْجَمَاعَةِ عَلَى صَلَاةِ الرَّجُلِ وَحْدَهُ بِضْعٌ وَعِشْرُونَ دَرَجَةً
content.english: Congregational prayer exceeds individual prayer by more than twenty degrees.

content.arabic: وَلَلْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنَ الْأُولَى
content.english: The Hereafter is far better for you than the present life.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمْ لَا يُرْحَمْ
content.english: Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.

content.arabic: إِنَّ أَثْقَلَ الصَّلَوَاتِ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ صَلَاةُ الْعِشَاءِ وَالْفَجْرِ
content.english: Among the hardest prayers for hypocrites are the night and dawn prayers.

content.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَى
content.english: Your Lord will surely give you until you are pleased.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
content.english: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

content.arabic: أَفْضَلُ صَلَاةِ الرَّجُلِ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ عَلَى صَلَاةِ الرَّجُلِ وَحْدَهُ خَمْسٌ وَعِشْرُونَ دَرَجَةً
content.english: A man’s prayer in congregation is twenty-five degrees better than his prayer alone.

content.arabic: فَأَمَّا الْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
content.english: So as for the orphan, do not oppress or mistreat him.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ فِي حَاجَةِ أَخِيهِ كَانَ اللَّهُ فِي حَاجَتِهِ
content.english: Whoever attends to his brother’s need, Allah will attend to his need.

content.arabic: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ النَّاسُ مَا فِي النِّدَاءِ وَالصَّفِّ الْأَوَّلِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَجِدُوا إِلَّا أَنْ يَسْتَهِمُوا عَلَيْهِ لَاسْتَهَمُوا
content.english: If people knew the merit of the adhan and the first row, they would draw lots for the opportunity.

content.arabic: وَأَمَّا السَّائِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
content.english: And as for the one who asks, do not rebuke him.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ أَخِيهِ
content.english: Allah continues to help the servant as long as the servant helps his brother.

content.arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ فَهُوَ كَقِيَامِ نِصْفِ لَيْلَةٍ، وَمَنْ صَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ وَالصُّبْحَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ فَهُوَ كَقِيَامِ لَيْلَةٍ
content.english: Praying ‘Isha in congregation is like standing half the night; adding Fajr is like standing the whole night.

content.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
content.english: Surely, together with hardship there is ease.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
content.english: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.

content.arabic: لَأَنْ أُصَلِّيَ الصُّبْحَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لَيْلَةً حَتَّى أُصْبِحَ
content.english: Praying Fajr in congregation was regarded as dearer than spending the whole night in voluntary prayer.

content.arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
content.english: Indeed, together with hardship there is ease.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: إِنَّ مِنْ أَحَبِّكُمْ إِلَيَّ وَأَقْرَبِكُمْ مِنِّي مَجْلِسًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَحَاسِنَكُمْ أَخْلَاقًا
content.english: Those dearest and nearest to me on the Day of Resurrection will be those with the best character.

content.arabic: شُهُودُهُمَا الْعِشَاءُ وَالصُّبْحُ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ قِيَامِ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا
content.english: Attending ‘Isha and Fajr is better than standing in prayer throughout the time between them.

content.arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانْصَبْ
content.english: When you become free, devote yourself earnestly to worship and effort.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الْأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ
content.english: Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in every matter.

content.arabic: لَأَنْ أُصَلِّيَ الْعِشَاءَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُحْيِيَ اللَّيْلَ كُلَّهُ
content.english: Praying ‘Isha in congregation was regarded as dearer than spending the entire night in worship.

content.arabic: وَإِلَى رَبِّكَ فَارْغَبْ
content.english: And direct your longing and eagerness toward your Lord.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: يَسِّرُوا وَلَا تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلَا تُنَفِّرُوا
content.english: Make things easy, not difficult; give glad tidings and do not drive people away.

content.arabic: كَانَتْ تَعْدِلُ صَلَاةُ الصُّبْحِ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ بِقِيَامِ اللَّيْلِ كُلِّهِ، وَصَلَاةُ الْعِشَاءِ بِنِصْفِ اللَّيْلِ
content.english: Fajr in congregation was considered equal to a whole night of prayer, and ‘Isha to half a night.

content.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
content.english: Say: Allah is One.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: اقْرَؤُوا الْقُرْآنَ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ شَفِيعًا لِأَصْحَابِهِ
content.english: Recite the Qur’an, for it will come on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor for its companions.

content.arabic: شُهُودُ صَلَاةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ قِيَامِ لَيْلَةٍ وَصِيَامِ يَوْمٍ
content.english: Attending an obligatory prayer was regarded as dearer than a night of voluntary prayer and a day of fasting.

content.arabic: اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ
content.english: Allah is sought by all and is in need of none.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
content.english: The best among you are those who learn the Qur’an and teach it.

content.arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ لَمْ تَفُتْهُ لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ
content.english: Whoever prays Maghrib and ‘Isha in congregation is described as not missing the blessing of Laylat al-Qadr.

content.arabic: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
content.english: He neither begets nor was He begotten.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: مَا اجْتَمَعَ قَوْمٌ فِي بَيْتٍ مِنْ بُيُوتِ اللَّهِ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَيَتَدَارَسُونَهُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِلَّا نَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّكِينَةُ
content.english: When people gather in a house of Allah to recite and study His Book, tranquility descends upon them.

content.arabic: مَنْ شَهِدَ الصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسَ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً فِي جَمَاعَةٍ يُدْرِكُ التَّكْبِيرَةَ الْأُولَى وَجَبَتْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ
content.english: Whoever attends the five prayers in congregation for forty nights and catches the opening takbir is promised Paradise in this report.

content.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
content.english: No one and nothing is equal or comparable to Him.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ
content.english: When Allah intends good for someone, He grants that person understanding of the religion.

content.arabic: مَنْ لَمْ تَفُتْهُ الرَّكْعَةُ الْأُولَى مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا كُتِبَتْ لَهُ بَرَاءَتَانِ: بَرَاءَةٌ مِنَ النَّارِ وَبَرَاءَةٌ مِنَ النِّفَاقِ
content.english: Whoever consistently catches the first rak‘ah for forty days is described as receiving protection from the Fire and hypocrisy.

content.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ
content.english: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of daybreak.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
content.english: Whoever follows a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes a path to Paradise easy for him.

content.arabic: رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَسْجُدُ فِي ص، وَلَيْسَتْ مِنْ عَزَائِمِ السُّجُودِ
content.english: Ibn ‘Abbas reported seeing the Prophet prostrate in Surah Sad, though it is not among the obligatory prostrations.

content.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
content.english: From the evil found among what He has created.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: مَنْ دَعَا إِلَى هُدًى كَانَ لَهُ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ مِثْلُ أُجُورِ مَنْ تَبِعَهُ
content.english: Whoever calls others to guidance receives rewards like those who follow it, without reducing their rewards.

content.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَرَأَ ص عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَنَزَلَ فَسَجَدَ
content.english: The Prophet recited Surah Sad on the pulpit, then came down and prostrated.

content.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
content.english: And from the evil of the dark night when it settles in.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: إِذَا مَاتَ ابْنُ آدَمَ انْقَطَعَ عَمَلُهُ إِلَّا مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ: صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
content.english: When a person dies, deeds end except for ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child who prays for them.

content.arabic: رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ سَجَدَ فِي ص
content.english: A report states that Ibn ‘Abbas prostrated on reciting Surah Sad.

content.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ
content.english: And from the evil of those who blow upon knots.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ، فَأَكْثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ
content.english: A servant is nearest to his Lord while prostrating, so increase your supplication then.

content.arabic: سَجَدَهَا دَاوُدُ تَوْبَةً، وَسَجَدْنَاهَا شُكْرًا
content.english: Dawud prostrated there in repentance, while this Ummah prostrates there in gratitude.

content.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
content.english: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: الدُّعَاءُ هُوَ الْعِبَادَةُ
content.english: Supplication is worship.

content.arabic: أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ كَانَ يَسْجُدُ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ
content.english: Abu Hurairah is reported to have prostrated when reciting Surah Al-Inshiqaq.

content.arabic: مَلِكِ النَّاسِ
content.english: The King of mankind.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
content.english: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should say what is good or remain silent.

content.arabic: كَانَ إِذَا قَرَأَ بِالنَّجْمِ سَجَدَ
content.english: Ibn ‘Abbas is reported to have prostrated when reciting Surah An-Najm.

content.arabic: إِلَهِ النَّاسِ
content.english: The God of mankind.
content.detail: Source: T. Usmani translation on Quran.com; English

content.arabic: بِحَسْبِ امْرِئٍ مِنَ الشَّرِّ أَنْ يَحْقِرَ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ
content.english: It is enough evil for a person to look down upon his Muslim brother.

content.arabic: قَرَأْتُهَا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَلَمْ يَسْجُدْ
content.english: Zayd ibn Thabit reported reciting it before the Prophet and that he did not prostrate on that occasion.
